message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) was one of the bloodiest single-day engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  In total, roughly **45,000 soldiers** were killed, wounded, or taken prisoner:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French (and allied German contingents) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch‑Prussian coalition | ~20,000 |

These figures include those killed, wounded, missing, and captured.  The exact numbers vary slightly among sources, but the consensus places the total at around forty‑five thousand.
